hunks.baseline: The moment he activated the secret device that only one person in the world was permitted to use, Vladimir Furin muttered to himself.
hunks.sol: The moment he activated the secret device that only one person in the world was permitted to use, Vladimir Furin thought:

hunks.baseline: He had to become greater than the tsars, who had ruled this land for generations through their noble blood, and greater even than the Iron Marshal, against whom no one had dared rebel.
hunks.sol: He had to become greater than the tsars, who had ruled this land for generations by virtue of their noble blood, and greater even than the Iron Marshal, against whom no one had dared rebel.

hunks.baseline: Time slowed, stretching out like a passing life flashing before his eyes. Then he saw the looter wearing a vivid smile.
hunks.sol: In the slow passage of time, like a life flashing before his eyes, he caught sight of the plunderer’s unmistakable smile.

hunks.baseline: The moment his shrewd eyes flew open—
hunks.sol: Furin’s shrewd eyes widened.

hunks.baseline: Would a swarm of thousands, tens of thousands of bees tangled together sound like this?
hunks.sol: Would thousands—tens of thousands—of bees swarming together sound like this?

hunks.baseline: Furin could only stare blankly at the vortex of flames as it rose from the melting floor of his office.
hunks.sol: Furin could only stare blankly at the vortex of flames rising through the melting floor of his office.

hunks.baseline: Surrounded by an aura as dark as pitch, it had been compressed into a great sphere, blazing like a tiny sun.
hunks.sol: Surrounded by an aura as dark as pitch, it had been compressed into a great sphere that blazed like a tiny sun.

hunks.baseline: And the old dictator staring at the sight in shock knew better than anyone that “tiny sun” was no exaggeration.
hunks.sol: And the old dictator, staring at it in shock, knew better than anyone that “tiny sun” was no exaggeration.

hunks.baseline: Only a handful of people involved knew that the most powerful hydrogen bomb of the Cold War—the one that had frozen the five oceans and six continents with fear—lay sleeping deep beneath the Kremlin.
hunks.sol: Only a handful of people knew that the most powerful hydrogen bomb of the Cold War—the one that had frozen the five oceans and six continents with fear—lay sleeping deep beneath the Kremlin.

hunks.baseline: They also knew that decades of secret experiments, carried out on the dictator’s orders, had given it a new name and destructive power far beyond anything it had possessed before.
hunks.sol: They also knew that decades of secret experiments, carried out on the dictator’s orders, had given it a new name and destructive power far beyond what it had possessed before.

hunks.baseline: “Remarkable. Truly remarkable. To create such powerful force. What do you humans call this weapon?”
hunks.sol: “Remarkable. Truly remarkable. To think you humans created power like this. What do you call this weapon?”

hunks.baseline: At Morgoth’s genuinely awestruck question, Furin—sensing that everything was over—answered in a hollow voice.
hunks.sol: At Morgoth’s genuine expression of awe, Furin—sensing that everything was over—answered in a hollow voice.

hunks.baseline: Morgoth looked from the old dictator, already all but fallen, to the catastrophic power named after him, then burst out laughing.
hunks.sol: Morgoth looked from the old dictator, already all but fallen, to the catastrophic power bearing his name. Then he laughed aloud.

hunks.baseline: A human granted barely a hundred years could harbor such enormous ambitions.
hunks.sol: That a human granted barely a hundred years could harbor such enormous ambitions.

hunks.baseline: At Morgoth’s words, which seemed to reveal he had already seen through everything, Furin quietly swallowed.
hunks.sol: At Morgoth’s words, as though he had already seen through everything, Furin quietly swallowed.

hunks.baseline: He was right. Tsar Bomba—or rather, the weapon now given the new name Vladimir—was not merely a product of science.
hunks.sol: He was right. Tsar Bomba—or rather, the weapon now called Vladimir—was not merely a product of science.

hunks.baseline: After that world-shaking event had overturned all the laws and common sense of the world, one thought had taken root in the mind of the dictator who had barely survived.
hunks.sol: After that event had overturned the world’s common sense and order, one thought had taken root in the mind of the dictator who had barely survived.

hunks.baseline: As one of the world’s great powers—and a dictatorship at that—the country had countless ways to obtain Magic Gems for experiments.
hunks.sol: As one of the world’s great powers—and a dictatorship at that—Russia had countless ways to obtain Magic Gems for the experiments.

hunks.baseline: Even if a second Demon King descended, he and Russia alone had to survive and rewrite the world order.
hunks.sol: Even if a second Demon King descended, he and Russia had to survive and rewrite the world order.

hunks.baseline: The decades he’d spent avoiding cigarettes counted for nothing. Furin had barely taken a few drags from the cigar. He stared at it, then suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: Despite decades of not smoking, Furin had managed only a few drags from the cigar. He stared at it blankly, then spoke.

hunks.baseline: At Morgoth’s kind offer, Furin raised his trembling hand and brought the cigar to his lips.
hunks.sol: At Morgoth’s kind offer, Furin raised a hand that shook like a leaf and brought the cigar to his lips.

hunks.baseline: Then, after taking the deepest drag of his life, he blew the smoke toward the monster before him.
hunks.sol: He drew deeper than he ever had before, then blew the smoke toward the monster before him.

hunks.baseline: Along with the name of the man who had crossed his mind just before he activated the bomb named after himself.
hunks.sol: He spoke the name of the man who had crossed his mind just before he activated the bomb bearing his own name.

hunks.baseline: With Morgoth’s calm reply, the pitch-black aura restraining the catastrophic power slowly dispersed, then enveloped its master.
hunks.sol: With Morgoth’s calm reply, the pitch-black aura restraining the catastrophic power slowly dispersed and enveloped its master.

hunks.baseline: Its destructive power packed into a volume that could fill a large truck: 50 Mt—fifty million tons of TNT.
hunks.sol: Packed into a volume that could fill a large truck was the destructive power of fifty megatons—fifty million tons of TNT.

hunks.baseline: Those were the figures publicly known for the Tsar Bomba.
hunks.sol: Those were the publicly known figures for Tsar Bomba.

hunks.baseline: Its power could make the Little Boy that had turned Hiroshima into a land of death during World War II seem like a little boy indeed.
hunks.sol: It had enough power to make Little Boy, the bomb that turned Hiroshima into a land of death during World War II, seem like a little boy indeed.

hunks.baseline: No one had expected this monster from a bygone era, born of the Cold War’s arms race, to awaken again more than eighty years later.
hunks.sol: No one had expected this monster from a bygone era, born of the Cold War’s displays of power, to awaken again more than eighty years later.

hunks.baseline: And no one had expected the monster’s first cry after its long sleep to ring out from the Kremlin.
hunks.sol: And no one had expected its first cry after that long sleep to ring out from the Kremlin.

hunks.baseline: The air trembled in an instant.
hunks.sol: The air trembled.

hunks.baseline: The soldiers and Hunters holding their posts as they suppressed their fear. The citizens who had fled into bomb shelters and out onto the streets as Red Square collapsed.
hunks.sol: The soldiers and Hunters holding their posts despite their fear. The citizens who had rushed into bomb shelters or out onto the streets when Red Square collapsed.

hunks.baseline: Everyone felt it and instinctively understood.
hunks.sol: Everyone felt it, and everyone instinctively understood.

hunks.baseline: A terrible heat beyond human perception, atomic power mingled with potent energy drawn from countless Magic Gems—it all spread out, devouring everything in its path.
hunks.sol: Terrible heat beyond human perception spread in every direction, along with atomic energy mingled with potent energy drawn from countless Magic Gems. It swallowed everything in its path.

hunks.baseline: Without end. Without restraint.
hunks.sol: Endlessly. Greedily.

hunks.baseline: Just as Icarus, who had flown too close to the sun, lost his wings and fell, the tiny sun born of a dictator’s ambition and fear swallowed countless lives, including its creator.
hunks.sol: Just as Icarus had lost his wings and fallen when he flew too close to the sun, the tiny sun born of a dictator’s ambition and fear swallowed countless lives, including his own.

hunks.baseline: Melted metal flowed like rivers, and above it rose a massive mushroom cloud, looming over the surface now transformed into a land of death.
hunks.sol: Molten metal flowed in rivers. Above it rose a massive mushroom cloud, looming over the surface now transformed into a land of death.

hunks.baseline: The moment Morgoth spread both hands with those quiet words—
hunks.sol: With those quiet words, Morgoth spread both hands.

hunks.baseline: Space trembled at Morgoth’s fingertips. He had been revered as the greatest of them, yet in the end he had chosen corruption of his own accord.
hunks.sol: Morgoth had been revered as the strongest among them, yet in the end he had chosen corruption of his own accord. At his fingertips, space trembled.

hunks.baseline: Gathering. Packing together. Rising up.
hunks.sol: Gathering. Compacting. Rising.

hunks.baseline: It was built.
hunks.sol: There it stood.

hunks.baseline: A gigantic castle, unlike anything ever seen in this world.
hunks.sol: A gigantic castle unlike anything ever seen in this world.

hunks.baseline: In place of concrete and marble, it stood upon pitch-black earth amid air saturated with dense magical power. It was overwhelming, yet beautiful. Morgoth smiled as he gazed at its spire piercing the clouds.
hunks.sol: Built not of concrete and marble, but of air saturated with dense magical power and pitch-black earth, it was overwhelming yet beautiful. Morgoth smiled as he gazed at its spire piercing the clouds.
